run_cut_with_align_files_cli: run the CLI to segment audio files using word alignment and VAD with configurable parameters
build_final_audio_segmenter: build a FinalAudioSegmenter instance to process multiple sessions with parallel multiprocessing
segment_word_align_data: segment word alignment data into cut indices based on silence boundaries and target segment size
cut_sils_from_audio: cut silence regions from audio data using alignment info and minimum silence/audio size thresholds
get_session_ids_matching: get session IDs that have both word alignment and audio alignment files for a given language
